summary: GLM-5.3-Flash can free about 0.9 GiB per GPU at TP2 for the KV cache
compatibility: Opt-in through VLLM_GLM53_EMBED_HOST=1, VLLM_GLM53_VISION_MXFP8=1 and VLLM_SHARE_PYNCCL_COMMS=1; all default to off.
details: VLLM_GLM53_EMBED_HOST keeps the input embedding table in pinned host RAM and reads the rows of the current tokens through UVA (0.59 GiB per GPU, lossless). Decode speed is unchanged; prefill is 1-3% slower.
VLLM_GLM53_VISION_MXFP8 quantizes the vision tower's linear layers to MXFP8 at load (0.24 GiB per GPU). ChartQA 79.8% vs 79.5% and OCR error 0.13% vs 0.07% against BF16.
VLLM_SHARE_PYNCCL_COMMS lets TP, DCP and EP groups over the same GPUs share one NCCL communicator (74 MiB per GPU at TP2+DCP2).
